title: External HRIS Integration
description: Architected and implemented a new authentication method for HRIS users using session IDs. Utilized AWS S3 objects to store info on pages users are allowed to access.

title: Vue 3 Migration
description: Migrated an entire supply management system from Vue 2 to Vue 3. Followed by a build tool migration from webpack to Vite, and a test runner migration from Jest to Vitest to modernize and improve the project's runtime.

title: E-learning Module Service
description: Developed the end-to-end e-learning module service, from database design, backend APIs, to user interfaces. Designed the module's categorization for the dashboard, progress auto-save feature, and pagination mechanism.
